messages.text: Russell tops Hamilton at Monza ahead of qualifying

metadata.summary: George Russell established himself as pole position favourite ahead of Italian Grand Prix qualifying as the Mercedes driver topped Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in final practice.
metadata.content: Italian GP: George Russell tops Lewis Hamilton in final practice as Mercedes appear to establish edge over Ferrari | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Breaking Italian GP: George Russell tops Lewis Hamilton in final practice as Mercedes appear to establish edge over Ferrari George Russell tops Lewis Hamilton in final practice at Monza; Mercedes appear to have edge over Ferrari going into qualifying; watch Italian Grand Prix Qualifying later on Saturday at 3pm, with build-up from 2.15pm, live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event Saturday 5 September 2026 13:10, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen fought a wheel-to-wheel battle for during P3 of the Italian Grand Prix at Monza George Russell established himself as pole position favourite ahead of Italian Grand Prix qualifying as the Mercedes driver topped Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in final practice. Mercedes and Ferrari had appeared closely matched in Friday's two practice sessions, and once more led the way on Saturday as Russell's time of 1:22.219s put him just over two tenths of a second clear of Hamilton at Monza. Russell is shouldering Mercedes' hopes of claiming pole, with his team-mate Kimi Antonelli, the championship leader, serving penalties for taking new engine parts that will leave him starting from the back of the grid regardless of where he qualifies. messages.text: Sky Sports and Audi launch unique 'Flying Lap' track guide series

metadata.content: Sky Sports and Audi launch 'Flying Lap' series in unique storytelling experience from F1 race tracks | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Sky Sports and Audi launch 'Flying Lap' series in unique storytelling experience from F1 race tracks Get closer than ever before to the technical and physical demands of an Formula 1 race circuit in a series combining real-life driving in an Audi RS5 road car with advanced simulation data Saturday 5 September 2026 09:22, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Powered by Audi: Martin Brundle takes to the iconic Monza track in a high-performance Audi, combining real laps with advanced sim data to break down racing lines, braking points, and elite-level performance. Sky Sports and their official Innovation partner Audi have launched a new series, combining real-world driving with Audi's R26 simulation technology to deliver a storytelling experience from the race track never seen before. At the heart of Flying Lap is Audi's cutting-edge simulation technology, placing the brand directly into the narrative of performance. By integrating Audi Sim data with Sky Sports ' world-class production, the series brings fans closer than ever to the technical and physical demands of the circuit.
